writeup.headline: SOPHiA GENETICS rates Hold at 63, just short of Buy, on strong growth and momentum offset by weak profitability.
writeup.thesis: SOPHiA GENETICS scores 63, a Hold that sits 2 points below the Buy threshold of 65. Growth is the strongest factor at 85, with TTM revenue growth of 18.6% and growth sped up by 14.1 pp from the previous quarter. The trend score of 86 is also strong: shares are up 97.6% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago, are 40.0 pp ahead of SPY over the last 126 trading days, and the price is 32.9% above its 200-day average. Quality holds the score back at 27, with an operating margin of -91.8%, an FCF margin of -47.2% and stock-based compensation at 21.0% of revenue, despite a gross margin of 67.4%. News is mildly positive at 58, helped by a new collaboration with Myriad Genetics, and the balance sheet and valuation were not scored, so the rating rests on the other four factors.
key_risks: Deep operating losses (operating margin of -91.8%) and cash burn (FCF margin of -47.2%) may require further funding.
Stock-based compensation at 21.0% of revenue and diluted share count up 2.2% year on year dilute existing holders.
Bank borrowings appear larger than the reported long-term debt, so total debt is uncertain.
After a 97.6% run-up the shares could pull back sharply if Q3 results on 2026-11-03 disappoint against the raised FY26 guidance of $94M–$96M.
Executives sold shares in October with no insider purchases.
what_would_change: A gain of 2 points, for example from better margins lifting the quality score or more positive news, would move the rating to Buy.
Q3 results on 2026-11-03 that confirm the growth acceleration and show narrowing losses could push the score over 65.
A drop of 19 points to below 45 would mean Sell, which would likely need a sharp reversal in the price trend together with slowing growth.
Clarity on total debt and valuation would add two unscored factors to the composite score and could shift it in either direction.
